subject.title: fix(plugins): bound marketplace manifest file reads

question: Should marketplace listing and installation reject manifests above 16 MiB and symlinked manifest paths by default?
rationale: The implementation correctly closes the unbounded allocation path, but the threshold and regular-file-only policy intentionally narrow marketplace inputs accepted by existing code.

options.title: Accept bounded contract
options.body: Keep the 16 MiB cap and regular-file-only requirement across marketplace listing and installation.

options.title: Tune accepted inputs
options.body: Adjust the threshold or file-kind policy while preserving the bounded, identity-checked read, cleanup behavior, diagnostics, and tests.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded contract
recommendation.body: Keep the 16 MiB cap and regular-file-only requirement across marketplace listing and installation.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the marketplace registry installation and shared loading behavior affected by this compatibility choice.
